kappa.title: Kappa Container Checklist

goals: Find and obtain the case containing military equipment
Obtain and hand over the case containing military equipment
Plant the letter at the second-floor reception desk of the TerraGroup office on Ground Zero in one raid
Plant WI-FI cameras at six designated locations on Shoreline, Streets, and Ground Zero
Hand over any five Black Division armored rigs
Retrieve the six WI-FI cameras planted during Cast the Net
Obtain the Black Division encryption key
Hand over ten specified Black Division equipment items found in raid
While wearing a Black Division rig, eliminate four Black Division members on each of Shoreline, Streets, and Ground Zero
Choose one route for the same laptop: hand it to Fence, or decrypt it and hand it to Mechanic
Eliminate 15 Black Division members in The Lab
Plant TP-200 TNT at the damaged fence sections west, north, and east of the Shoreline resort
Destroy two transmitters on Customs and two on Woods
Hand over the data extracted from the Black Division rugged laptop
Transit Shoreline → Lighthouse → Reserve → Woods in one continuous raid, and eliminate 10 targets other than Black Division while completing the other objectives
Complete the required Interchange sequence in one raid, transit to Streets of Tarkov, plant the case, and survive the raid
Eliminate 3 PMCs each on Customs, Woods and Streets of Tarkov during 22:00–08:00 in-game, and stash 3 PMC dogtags at each designated site (9 kills and 9 dogtags total)
guides: Find 1 case at one of three Shoreline spawns: the shack by Sordi tower, Weather Station second floor, or Power Station first floor.
Take the case from Part 1 to a BTR stop on Woods or Streets and hand 1 case to the BTR Driver.
Plant Therapist's letter at the TerraGroup HQ second-floor reception. Dying or using an extract other than EMERCOM Checkpoint or Nakatani Basement fails the task.
Bring 6 WI-FI Cameras: place one at each Shoreline Ural truck and excavator, Streets concrete mixer and Rodina portable toilet, and Ground Zero cargo truck cab and underground yellow bus.

Hand over any 5 Black Division plate carriers, obtained on Ground Zero (level 21+), Shoreline, Streets, The Lab, or Icebreaker. The LV-119 MultiCam Black worn by The Wedge on Icebreaker is also accepted.

Recover and hand over all 6 cameras from the same locations used in Cast the Net.
Quest reward: Briefcase with documents — keep it for the follow-up quest What's in the Bag?.
Loot 1 Found in Raid encryption key from Black Division roaming standard locations and hand it over. It cannot be obtained on Icebreaker.

Hand over 1 Found in Raid item of each type: Siege-R, LV-119 V1, LV-119 V2 and FCPC V5 carriers; Modular Pack 45 Plus, 2 Day Assault Pack and NICE Frame Load Sling; M53A1, SOTR and Gatorz Specter. Available from Black Division crates.
Hand over 1 Found in Raid briefcase. Obtain it from the Reverse Gear reward, exchange 5 Black Division tokens at the Cultist Circle, or find it as a rare Black Division drop.
Hand over 3 Found in Raid 14-4 KORD SSDs. They can spawn in Black Division areas, most commonly on Streets, Shoreline, and The Lab. Icebreaker excluded.
Wear a Black Division plate carrier and eliminate 4 operatives on Shoreline, 4 on Streets, and 4 on Ground Zero: 12 total.

Final Stretch and Consequences of Our Decisions are mutually exclusive. Give the laptop directly to Fence, or decrypt it at Intelligence Center level 1 and give it to Mechanic. Either route unlocks Desperate Assault.
Eliminate 15 Black Division operatives in The Lab; operatives spawned after an extract is activated also count.
Bring 3 TP-200 TNT bricks and plant one at each west, north, and east Health Resort fence breach on Shoreline.
Destroy 4 transmitters: the factory chimney and power-line tower on Customs, plus the mountain top and cell tower on Woods.
Obtain a Black Division rugged laptop from Black Division operatives (excluding Icebreaker), decrypt it at Intelligence Center level 1, and hand 1 data item to Mechanic.

Start on Shoreline and use all three transits in order. During the same continuous raid, eliminate 10 targets other than Black Division while completing the other objectives. Do not engage Black Division.

Complete every objective in a single raid. Bring an Object #11SR keycard and an RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow). On Interchange, eliminate 3 PMCs between 20:00 and 08:00 → turn on the power at the Power Station → use #11SR in the Burger Spot bathroom to activate the saferoom → pull the lever inside the saferoom to open container #14 → retrieve the case → transit to Streets of Tarkov → plant the case on the third floor of the Pinewood Hotel → fire the yellow flare near the crashed tram → extract alive. Completing the quest unlocks Historical Prospects.

A Dorm room 314 marked key is required to enter the third-floor marked room on Customs. PMC dogtags do not need Found in Raid status. You can progress across multiple raids; the quest does not have to be completed in a single raid. Stash locations: the marked room on Customs; the abandoned village marked circle on Woods; the marked circle in the second-floor apartment at Nikitskaya St. 8 on Streets. The stash objectives do not list a time restriction.
achievements: Reach level 30 with no positive perks
Reach level 30 with at least 10 negative traits
Pick the five specified negative traits and reach level 30
One Is Good, Two Is Better
Select Kappa Protocol and obtain another Kappa
Pick Broken Secure Container and No Flea Market, then obtain Kappa normally
Pick 5 survival perks and finish every survival-path task
Pick Street Tax and hold 500M₽, 1M€, and 1M$ at once
otherAchievements: Reach level 30 with a seasonal character
Have every type of TerraGroup documentation in your inventory, excluding Classified Documents
Eliminate 100 Black Division operatives while using their equipment
Obtain Secure container Kappa after the Seasons system was introduced
Complete Fence's KORD BREACH task line and hand the unknown-facility laptop to Mechanic or Fence
global: Black Division operatives can be encountered on specific locations
Hideout zones do not require Found in Raid status
Traders across Tarkov are experiencing an armor shortage
Crafting time is reduced by 50%; Crafting starts at level 51
Your character gains 25% more raid experience
